name: smart-canteen
description: Smart Canteen Management System - Dual Portals (Canteen + Staff)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix staff-portal
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,CANTEEN,STAFF" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix staff-portal"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,CANTEEN,STAFF" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix staff-portal"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix staff-portal
scripts.deploy:canteen: npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name namma-canteen-student
scripts.deploy:staff: npx wrangler pages deploy staff-portal/dist --project-name namma-canteen-staff
